plain_english_policy: Enactment would authorize a specific portion (up to $5 million) of the Shoals Economic Development Fund in Lauderdale and Colbert Counties to be used exclusively for workforce training and economic development programs at the University of North Alabama. This creates a new permissible use case within an existing special fund, distinct from other authorized uses like industrial location incentives or administrative costs.
policy_direction_if_enacted: The policy direction is to expand the scope of allowable expenditures from the Shoals Economic Development Fund by adding university-based workforce training and economic development programs as a funded activity. This directs public funds toward educational partnerships aimed at enhancing local labor skills rather than direct business location incentives or infrastructure projects.
sponsorship_supports_position: Representative Morrow (N & P) sponsored the bill affirmatively advancing this specific amendment to Section 45-17-91.23.
evidence_quotes: to provide that a portion of the Shoals Economic Development Fund may be for workforce training and economic development programs at the University of North Alabama.
To expend an equal match of up to five million dollars ($5,000,000) which shall be expended for workforce training and economic development programs at the University of North Alabama.
